change_summary: Material sensing-quality recovery since the 09:04 CDT snapshot. Direct browser checks of the Grand Hotel and Fairhope Hazcams live players at 17:02–17:03 CDT showed advancing playback, advancing seekable endpoints and visible scene progression, so both are admitted as probably fresh, scoped qualitative observations with exact source delay and capture time unknown. Neither visible interval showed obvious Jubilee evidence; Fairhope shows neither beach, and fine biology was often not assessable. All six owner cameras are healthy on the synchronized 16:06–16:09 CDT capture identity and within 60 minutes at snapshot time, with daylight good visibility, slight ripple and no resolved Jubilee signal in visible Point Clear/Montrose areas. Current 15Z NGOFS2 Point Clear model guidance is available: its 1-hour forward projection is slightly seaward while 3–12 hour projections are shoreward; this remains MODEL guidance and does not change weights. Fresh upstream USGS discharge is available at explicit stations but lag to Mobile Bay is uncalibrated. No credible same-day Jubilee report was found.
